notes: Extra edge cases beyond the samples: new layouts in every format, unusual date and number formats, more fraud signals, duplicates and revisions across formats, and inputs that are not normal invoices. Statuses are the expected outcome for fixtures/holdout run as one folder on a fresh ledger (sorted order), so the _copy and _revised files follow their originals. kind: clean, code (decided by validation), judgment (the VP's call), duplicate, revision, date-format and limitation.

invoice_3001.txt.why: Clean text invoice in a new layout ($2,650.00)

invoice_3001_copy.pdf.why: Same invoice as invoice_3001.txt, resubmitted as a PDF; already paid in this run

invoice_3002.csv.why: Clean CSV with different column names ($2,050.00)

invoice_3002_revised.csv.why: Same invoice number as invoice_3002.csv (already paid) asking a different amount
